implementation: Shared Metal backend completion service coalesces pending scope-pop registrations. Only one servicing worker is launched for a concurrent burst; weak scope registrations avoid owning cancelled futures, and worker/registration storage retire when requests drain
limits: Burst test holds synthetic submission leases on an actual Metal backend; not physical fault or throughput qualification
Service worker uses backend wait_idle and cannot cancel driver waits
Registration storage is proportional to active scope waits; no global bound on separately created backend instances
Wall-time, OS thread sampling, energy/RSS and cross-platform qualification remain open
